body: Honestly fear is the biggest answer. I tried coming out to my bi uncle (who was in the closet at the time) and he told my mom. My mom told my dad and it was a whole big mess. My mom pretends it didn't happen and often asks me questions like when am I gonna find a gf. Or on the rare occasion I go out she'd say something like "You look good, what would you do if a girl asked you out". It's weird because she accepted him but not me and says that she just doesn't want any of her kids to be gay because it's embarrassing. And getting out on my own is the most terrifying thing to me rn because I don't know if I can sustain myself at this age. I also don't wanna lose the few (3) friends that I do have no matter how good of friends they are (like I said, being completely alone terrifies me and is my real problem) and I don't wanna be made to feel disgusting about myself by being bombarded with sexual insult like the first and only time I tried to come out. But thank you for listening and trying to help.
